title: US in possession of exotic material

tellings.quote: it is my uh belief that the United States is in possession of uh of exotic material

plain: The United States holds strange material of unknown origin, according to Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official. He tells Michels it is his "belief that the United States is in possession of exotic material". If he is right, the government would be keeping physical evidence of something it cannot explain.
